name: In-play sports feed-latency taking
one_line: Lift stale in-play quotes in the second after a goal, score or kill using a signal that beats the makers' cancel (scout, licensed feed, parsed game state), through a 1-second non-cancellable in-game taker delay.
maturity: Emerging and shrinking; PnL hard data for RN1 (live) and swisstony (inactive since 2026-08-26) but their mechanism is unverified; the only documented pure case (esports parser) stopped Dec 2025
requires_ai: no; optional stream-overlay vision for esports
edge: Seconds between the true event and the maker's cancel; delay-bounded
capital: $1k-$10k esports/tennis, $10k+ football/NFL: stale size per event binds, not bankroll
build_time: 3-6 weeks plumbing; the signal source is the real project
opportunity_size: Sports ~$10M/day in sample; stale size per event: $k esports, ~$16k within 5c on a live soccer match, $10k+ NFL; shrinking under delays and desks
expected_results: RN1 +$1.62M/30d on $186M (0.87%); copier 1 s late -8%/week; solo guess -$1k to +$2k/month
competition: RN1, Kch-Temp, salaried desks, makers on the same feeds
flag: grey: courtsiding law (Victoria), venue terms, data licences, PM data clause
validate: Two-weekend replay: signal vs book-move time and stale size surviving 1 s; pass ≥$50/event over 40 events
top_risk: 1-s non-cancellable delay lets fast makers pull first; reversals
solo_fit_reason: Free venue data and a cheap replay test, but no affordable signal beats the book after the 1-second delay; every retail feed loses the race, licensed feeds cost EUR 1,000+ per title and exclude betting use, and the two big wallets may be running models rather than feeds. Viable only with an own esports parser or a scout, and then depth-capped.
speed_class: latency-critical: 90% of repricing within 0.5 s, 1-s delay, tens of ms decide capture
results_1k: only with a free sub-second signal; -$70 to +$130/month (guess, expectation near zero)
results_10k: esports with licensed feed; -$1,000 to +$1,300/month (guess, feed cost ~$1,200)
min_capital: ~$2k once a replay shows the signal beats the book
capacity_ceiling: stale size per event; ~$10-30k working capital solo (guess)
monthly_running_cost: minimum ~$20-70; comfortable ~$1,200-1,600 with one licensed esports feed
changes_made: Live Gamma scan: secondsDelay 1 s on all live sports, 0 on MLB; help-centre 3 s figure is stale; World Cup zero-delay window documented from Polymarket's own post.

swisstony shown inactive from its wallet since 2026-08-26 with $0 30-day volume; RN1 documented live (taker fills ~29/hour plus a faster tape of resting-order fills); TeemuTeemuTeemu stopped 2025-12-29.
Per-event depth measured on live and pre-game books; fee split (zero_fees only on the game-day NFL game) recorded.
Maturity downgraded from the brief's hypothesis; category kept as Information edge (latency).

Verifier 2026-09-28 16:07-16:11 UTC: all 34 sources re-fetched or re-run; header grade set to B overall; zero_fees reconciled as a game-day switch (every NFL/CFB game 4-29 days out at 0.05); swisstony's +$761k month PnL on $0 volume explained as resolutions of August positions; TeemuTeemuTeemu side split attributed to /activity vs /trades; Belgium-France depth attributed to the France-to-win side and a genuine in-play soccer depth point (Georgia-Ukraine, $16k/$12k within 5c) added; NBA arbitrage paper figures re-stated per abstract; sports WebSocket payload's sportradarGameId noted; Sportmonks Enterprise EUR 499 marked unverified; Wikipedia courtsiding cases labelled pre-2025; PandaScore betting restriction nuanced; E9 scraping wording corrected; $1k gross upper bound cut from $300 to $200.

RN1 fill statistics re-based on taker-only fills (Data API /trades defaults to takerOnly=true, re-run 16:24 UTC): ~29 taker fills/hour, median $106, 26% of gaps ≤ 2 s; the all-fills tape (~290/hour, median $27, 45% of gaps ≤ 2 s) is mostly resting-order fills and had been used for the burst claims.
open_doubts: Whether RN1 and swisstony trade off a feed or a model cannot be settled from public data.
In-play soccer depth rests on one live measurement (Georgia-Ukraine, ten minutes in); NFL in-play stale size is still inferred from pre-game depth.
MLB secondsDelay 0 and the 'lock during plays' mechanism rest on one Reddit post.
The 90%-within-0.5 s repricing figure is one self-reported test with no fills.
Data API /trades and /activity attribute trade sides differently; wallet buy/sell splits depend on the endpoint.
Courtsiding legal sources beyond Wikipedia (LawInSport, Sport Integrity Australia) returned HTTP 403; Sportmonks Enterprise price unverified.
Most of RN1's fill count comes from its resting orders being hit; its taker rate is ~29 fills/hour, which weakens the in-play-lifting attribution further.
